items.claim: Anthony Hernandez exhibited extremely poor fight IQ and executed a terrible game plan by trying to strike with Sean Strickland for 25 minutes in his previous fight.
items.quote: he came in there with the worst game plan I've ever seen in my entire life. He went out there and his game plan was to strike with Sean Strickland for 25 minutes.

items.claim: Anthony Hernandez failed to effectively attempt any wrestling or takedowns in his last fight.
items.quote: it says he was he was officially credited with one takedown attempt. Um I didn't see a a takedown attempt in that fight.
